scientific_integrity: The ordinary-list K_{2,k^2} obstruction is prior literature and is explicitly not claimed as new. Novelty claim concerns the simultaneous exact thresholds and DP factor-two forbidden-pair mechanism. Finite checks support, but do not establish, the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Proved for K_{2,n} with integer n>=3; no extension to K_{m,n} for m>=3 or to general networks. Source-coverage comparison is not a proof of historical priority.
title: Exact degree-truncated list and DP thresholds on two-hub bicliques
